blurb: Guests roll up their sleeves to become winemakers for a day by tasting, experimenting, and creating their own signature wine blends in hands-on classes led by expert instructors. They taste three distinct single-varietal wines and learn the art and science of blending. Options include instructor-led workshops and a more flexible Open Lab for confident self-starters.
